_note: Fix guide. Every alert points at one entry here by id. 'verified' is true only where the doc page was read while building this; otherwise the link is the vendor's documentation entry point and the details need a VERIFY check against the live page.

runbooks.title: Sarvam returns 402 (credits exhausted)
runbooks.symptom: API calls fail with HTTP 402 / insufficient_quota_error. All keys in the organisation fail at once.
runbooks.cause: Organisation credit balance reached zero. Credits are shared by every workspace and key.
steps: Open the Sarvam dashboard > Settings > Billing and add credits.
Turn on Auto-Recharge so it does not recur.
Enter the new balance in this dashboard (Setup > balances) so runway is correct.
Retry failed requests; 402 calls were not billed and are not retried by Sarvam.
runbooks.verify: VERIFY exact menu names and whether Auto-Recharge is available on your plan.

runbooks.title: Sarvam returns 403 (invalid API key)
runbooks.symptom: HTTP 403 / invalid_api_key_error.
runbooks.cause: Key revoked, mistyped, or sent in the wrong header.
steps: Confirm the key in the dashboard is active.
Check the service sends it in the header Sarvam documents (api-subscription-key).
Rotate the key, update the secret in AWS Secrets Manager, redeploy.
runbooks.verify: VERIFY header name against the current docs.

runbooks.title: Sarvam rate limit (429)
runbooks.symptom: HTTP 429 bursts, usually during campaign peaks.
runbooks.cause: Requests per minute above the plan limit.
steps: Add exponential backoff with jitter in the caller.
Spread campaign start times.
Ask Sarvam for a higher limit or move to a higher plan (FOR FOUNDER REVIEW: commercial).
runbooks.verify: VERIFY per-plan limits.

runbooks.title: Sarvam server errors (5xx)
runbooks.symptom: HTTP 500/502/503 from Sarvam.
runbooks.cause: Vendor-side fault or overload.
steps: Retry with backoff (up to 3 tries).
If it persists for more than 15 minutes, switch the agent to its fallback provider if configured.
Raise a ticket with Sarvam with request IDs.
runbooks.verify: VERIFY status page and support channel.

runbooks.title: Sarvam balance must be entered by hand
runbooks.symptom: Runway is blank or out of date.
runbooks.cause: Sarvam has no balance API, so this dashboard cannot read it.
steps: Read the balance from Sarvam Settings > Billing.
Run: python -m rm.balance sarvam credits <amount_inr>  (or use POST /api/balance).
Do this at least every 2 days, or after each top-up.
runbooks.verify: VERIFY that no balance endpoint has been added since.

runbooks.title: AWS sync denied or failing
runbooks.symptom: Cost or credit sync reports AccessDenied or an expired token.
runbooks.cause: The IAM identity lacks Cost Explorer / Billing read permission, or Cost Explorer is not enabled, or the session expired.
steps: Use the minimal read-only policy in the README (ce:GetCostAndUsage, ce:GetCostForecast, plus the Billing credits read action).
Cost Explorer must be enabled once in the management account.
Billing APIs are served from us-east-1.
Re-run: python -m rm.collect --vendor aws
runbooks.verify: VERIFY the IAM action name for the Billing GetCredits API and the boto3 client name.

runbooks.title: AWS credits running out or expiring
runbooks.symptom: Runway under 45 days or a credit expires within 30 days.
runbooks.cause: Spend is consuming credits faster than planned, or credits have an end date.
steps: Open Billing > Credits and note which credits expire first and which services they cover.
Check the top services in this dashboard; right-size or stop idle resources.
Ask the AWS account manager about extending or adding credits (FOR FOUNDER REVIEW: commercial).
Plan the cash cost from the expiry date: forecast x INR rate.
runbooks.verify: VERIFY page address; AWS reorganises billing docs often.

runbooks.title: AWS spend without client or product tags
runbooks.symptom: Large share of spend shows as Unassigned.
runbooks.cause: Resources lack the tags, or the tags are not activated as cost-allocation tags.
steps: Billing > Cost allocation tags: activate the client, product and env tags (takes up to 24 hours to appear).
Tag resources, or enforce tags with a tag policy / SCP.
Tags apply from activation onwards, not retroactively.
runbooks.verify: VERIFY page address.

runbooks.title: AWS forecast above monthly budget
runbooks.symptom: Month-end forecast is over the budget in .env.
runbooks.cause: Spend run-rate is higher than planned.
steps: See top services this month.
Find the day the run-rate stepped up in the daily chart.
Create an AWS Budget with email alerts at 80% so this fires earlier.
runbooks.verify: VERIFY page address.

runbooks.title: Vobiz sync failing (401/403)
runbooks.symptom: Call records stop updating; sync message mentions auth.
runbooks.cause: Auth ID or token wrong or rotated.
steps: Check VOBIZ_AUTH_ID and VOBIZ_AUTH_TOKEN in .env against the Vobiz console.
Regenerate the token if needed and update .env.
Re-run: python -m rm.collect --vendor vobiz
runbooks.verify: VERIFY auth header names and the causes of 401; Vobiz does not document them.

runbooks.title: Vobiz balance low
runbooks.symptom: Available balance at or under the low-balance threshold, or under 5 days of calling.
runbooks.cause: Prepaid balance is being consumed by calls.
steps: Top up from the Vobiz console.
Check cost per answered call by campaign for waste (very short or unanswered calls billed).
Confirm the account's credit-limit type so you know what happens at zero.
runbooks.verify: VERIFY behaviour at zero balance; not documented.

runbooks.title: Vobiz concurrency limit reached
runbooks.symptom: Concurrent calls near the limit; new calls rejected with 429.
runbooks.cause: Campaign dialling rate above the number of channels.
steps: Lower the dialler pace so concurrent calls stay under 90% of the limit.
Stagger campaigns of different clients.
Request more channels from Vobiz (FOR FOUNDER REVIEW: commercial).
runbooks.verify: VERIFY how limits are raised.

runbooks.title: Answer rate dropped
runbooks.symptom: Today's answer rate is well under the 7-day average.
runbooks.cause: Caller ID flagged as spam, a bad data batch, a time-of-day shift, or a carrier issue.
steps: Split answer rate by caller number in this dashboard; one number low points to a spam flag.
Check hangup causes for a spike in one cause.
Rotate the caller ID and check the dialling window.
Compare against a batch with known good numbers.
runbooks.verify: VERIFY hangup cause meanings with Vobiz.

runbooks.title: Call quality problems
runbooks.symptom: Share of answered calls with low MOS, high jitter or packet loss, or media timeouts above 2%.
runbooks.cause: Network path between Vobiz and the agent runtime, or a carrier route issue.
steps: Check whether it is one caller number or all.
Check the agent's media server region and network health.
Share affected call IDs with Vobiz support.
runbooks.verify: VERIFY quality field names and thresholds (MOS<3.5, jitter>30, loss>1 are this tool's assumptions).

runbooks.title: Collections calls outside 8am to 7pm
runbooks.symptom: Kollect calls started before 8am or at/after 7pm IST.
runbooks.cause: Campaign schedule or timezone set wrongly.
steps: Pause the campaign now.
Fix the schedule in IST and add a hard stop at 7pm.
Record the incident with call IDs for compliance review (FOR FOUNDER REVIEW).
RBI Fair Practices Code and recovery-agent norms allow collection calls only in the 8am to 7pm window.

docs.label: RBI Fair Practices Code (search the RBI site)

runbooks.verify: VERIFY the current RBI circular reference with compliance.

runbooks.title: Interakt webhook silent
runbooks.symptom: No webhook events for 12+ hours during working hours.
runbooks.cause: Webhook disabled by Interakt after repeated failures, the server is down, or the URL changed.
steps: Check this server is up and the public HTTPS URL answers.
Re-save the webhook URL in Interakt Developer Settings to re-enable it.
Confirm the secret matches INTERAKT_WEBHOOK_SECRET (signature failures return 401).
Missed events are not replayed; counts for the gap will be low.
runbooks.verify: VERIFY the auto-disable rule and the developer-settings path.

runbooks.title: Interakt wallet balance must be entered by hand
runbooks.symptom: Wallet balance missing, stale or running low.
runbooks.cause: No wallet API is documented, so it cannot be read automatically. Sends fail when the wallet is empty.
steps: Read the wallet from the Interakt dashboard.
Run: python -m rm.balance interakt wallet <amount_inr>.
Top up before runway drops under a week.
runbooks.verify: VERIFY no wallet endpoint exists.

runbooks.title: Interakt failures with no mapped code
runbooks.symptom: Failure rate high and the top error code is not in the guide.
runbooks.cause: Unmapped Meta/Interakt error.
steps: Look up the code in the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API error list.
Open a ticket with Interakt including 3 message IDs.
runbooks.verify: VERIFY page address.

runbooks.title: Message undeliverable (131026, 131047, 131056)
runbooks.symptom: Failures with 131026 (undeliverable), 131047 (outside 24h window) or 131056 (pair rate limit).
runbooks.cause: Number not on WhatsApp, user not opted in or blocked, free-form message outside the 24h window, or too many messages to one user.
steps: Clean the list: remove numbers that failed 131026 twice.
Outside the 24h window send an approved template, not free text.
For 131056 slow down messages to the same user.
runbooks.verify: VERIFY code meanings on the live page.

runbooks.title: WhatsApp throughput limit (130429)
runbooks.symptom: 130429 errors during bursts.
runbooks.cause: Sending faster than the number's messages-per-second limit.
steps: Queue and throttle sends.
Retry with backoff.
runbooks.verify: VERIFY limit for your tier.

runbooks.title: Marketing limits and quality (131048, 131049, 131050)
runbooks.symptom: Spam-rate limit, or Meta chose not to deliver a marketing message, or the user opted out of marketing.
runbooks.cause: Low quality rating or users blocking/reporting.
steps: Check the number's quality rating in WhatsApp Manager.
Reduce marketing frequency and tighten targeting.
Honour opt-outs immediately.
Do not retry 131049; Meta decides per user.
runbooks.verify: VERIFY code meanings on the live page.

runbooks.title: Template problems (132000 to 132016)
runbooks.symptom: Parameter count mismatch, template not found, paused or disabled.
runbooks.cause: Variables do not match the approved template, wrong language code, or template paused for low quality.
steps: Compare variables sent with the approved template body.
Confirm name and language code.
If paused, edit and resubmit or create a new template.
runbooks.verify: VERIFY code meanings on the live page.

runbooks.title: Account or payment problem (131042, 131031, 368, 190, 100, 133010)
runbooks.symptom: Payment issue, account locked, token expired, or number not registered.
runbooks.cause: Billing method on the WhatsApp Business Account, policy restriction, or expired access token.
steps: Check payment method and account status in Meta Business Manager.
Check the account's policy notices.
Contact Interakt support for token or registration issues.
runbooks.verify: VERIFY code meanings on the live page.

runbooks.title: Spend with no purpose
runbooks.symptom: A large share of a vendor's spend shows as Unassigned.
runbooks.cause: No rule in purposes.json matches the campaign, number, workspace or template.
steps: Open the Unassigned rows in the service view and note the campaign ID, number, workspace or template name.
Add a rule to purposes.json (first match wins; keys ending _prefix match the start).
Re-run the collector; past rows are re-attributed on the next collect.
